prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a huge giant with charred black-grey skin cracked with glowing orange molten veins, a mane of flaming orange hair and a flaming beard (drawn as part of the head), a scorched leather smith's apron and iron bracers, holding one huge iron forge hammer; in the idle cell the hammer rests on his shoulder close to the body; tall and filling the box, centred in its own cell, and the whole hammer stays well inside its cell in every cell. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its charred face with glowing orange eyes inside the flaming hair is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, stepping forward toward the heroes at the end of a downward slam: the hammer held in both hands, its head on the ground just in front of his front foot, the body leaning in, the whole hammer well inside the middle cell (not raised overhead, not reaching the cell edge), facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, staggering, both hands still gripping the hammer held up across his chest, the flaming hair flattened, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso and swing the hammer with the elbows bent, so every reaching part stays well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts and clothing named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak, scarf or extra cloth, and no smear, motion arc, motion lines or sparks. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, furs, a tree club, ice, a cape, a sword, an anvil, flames outside the body, sparks.
